elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 requires Customer to pay the Termination for Convenience Fee, and Section 13.5 expressly deems that fee liquidated damages.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 identifies the Termination for Convenience Fee as liquidated damages and states that it is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer; Section 11.2(A) eliminates the Termination for Cause Fee.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 limits the Termination for Convenience Fee to an amount “not to exceed three (3) months of fees payable by Customer under this Agreement.”

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 13.5 expressly provides that the Termination for Convenience Fee “is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement.”
